targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "iperf_results" and r._field == "bitrate")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${host:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "network-monitor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "iperf_results" and r._field == "jitter")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${host:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "network-monitor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "iperf_results" and r._field == "lost_percentage")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${host:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "network-monitor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ping_results" and r._field == "latency")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${host:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "network-monitor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interruptions" and r._field == "interruption_time")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${host:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "network-monitor")
 |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
 |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "iperf_results" and r._field == "executed_command")
 |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${host:regex}$/)
 |> group() |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true) |> limit(n: 100)
